files.description: Full HTML of the ONC certification page containing the inline EHI Export documentation section, Meaningful Use information, and links to API documentation.

Extracted HTML fragment of just the EHI Export section from the certification page. Contains the complete inline documentation of the EHI export workflow, format descriptions, and access instructions.

Patient Health Data API Documentation v1.1 (April 2018). 7-page PDF documenting a proprietary REST API for patient data access. Returns CCDA XML in JSON wrappers. Endpoints for authentication, patient search, full CCDA retrieval, and section-specific queries. Lists available clinical sections (demographics, allergies, encounters, goals, immunizations, medications, problems, procedures, results, vitals, etc.).

SmartOnFHIR API Documentation. 67-page PDF documenting the (g)(10) FHIR R4 API with SMART on FHIR OAuth2 authorization. Covers Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Immunization, Medication, MedicationDispense, Observation, Organization, Procedure, Provenance, ServiceRequest, Coverage, Specimen, RelatedPerson resources. This is the standardized API documentation, not the (b)(10) EHI export.

FHIR Service Base URLs. JSON FHIR Bundle containing Endpoint and Organization resources listing the FHIR server base URL (https://fhir.phemr.co:9443/fhirserver/fhir/) for two sample organizations. Required for (g)(10) API discovery.

Supplemental costs and technical limitations document (May 2018). Describes costs for capabilities like Direct Messaging and transitions of care. Not directly related to EHI export but included as it was linked from the certification page.
